text:
Maya Patel: Quick kickoff — SI integrator pilot with AcmeHW + cloud marketplace tomorrow. Looking for alignment on training lab access, certification rubric, and any co-marketing / announcement constraints.
Carlos Nguyen: Thanks Maya. Can you confirm the list of SIs that will be in scope and whether they get dedicated GPU sandboxes or shared?
Maya Patel: Initial cohort = 4 SI teams (North America). Prefer dedicated sandboxes for the first week for hands-on certs.
Priya Desai: For private deployments, we need to surface networking/VPC requirements up front. Can we share a one-pager for each SI before the lab?
Jordan Lee: I can draft the one-pager. Also we should lock a dry-run session 48h before the public workshop.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Dry-run on Thu 10am PT. Jordan, can you host?
Jordan Lee: Yep, I'll host. I'll also prep the demo flow and failover test checklist.
Carlos Nguyen: Ops note — provisioning ETA for dedicated sandboxes is ~3 hours once requested. ops-bot will post the link here when done.
ops-bot: sandbox-provisioner: Provision request queued. ETA 3h.
Samira Khan: Certification question: Are we doing a pass/fail lab plus a short written rubric? I suggest: hands-on lab (70% pass) + 15-min oral Q&A. Badge issued on pass.
Maya Patel: That rubric sounds good. Samira, can you own the exam doc and publish to the SI folder?
Samira Khan: On it. Draft will be in the partnership drive by EOD.
Carlos Nguyen: Marketplace listing checklist (quick):
- Product tile + short description
- Pricing tier and supported regions
- Tested instance types / GPU SKUs
- Security & compliance notes (KMS/HSM)
- Contact & support link
Make sure the SI has a marketing-friendly blurb for co-branding.
Priya Desai: Also add network requirements and the private deployment matrix. We'll need this for Dedicated vs Private packaging.
Maya Patel: For the hands-on lab, we'll provide a jump box and pre-built model snapshot. Quick creds above.
Carlos Nguyen: Pasting the sandbox access snippet (replace creds):
```
ssh redwood-sandbox@34.82.10.55 -i ~/.ssh/redwood_pilot.pem
# login then sudo su - labadmin
```
Maya Patel: Please don't share PEM publicly — use partner-specific accounts.
Jordan Lee: Demo flow outline (short):
1) Deploy model variant -> 2) Run load + validate latency targets -> 3) Failover to fallback model -> 4) Verify logs & tracing show expected traces.
Samira Khan: Small ask: can marketing signoff on co-announcement copy before we go live? We should avoid specific customer names unless approved.
Maya Patel: Yes — legal/marketing signoff required. I'll loop in product-marketing after the dry-run.
Carlos Nguyen: Timeline check:
- Today: finalize SI list + cert rubric (Samira)
- EOD: sandbox requests (Carlos/ops)
- Thu 10am PT: dry-run (Jordan)
- Fri: final signoffs + publish marketplace draft
- Next Tue: pilot workshop
Priya Desai: I'm adding a small network testing script to the drive. Will ping when uploaded.
ops-bot: sandbox-provisioner: 3 sandboxes ready -> https://console.redwood/sandbox/1721 :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Awesome. Thanks everyone. I'll send calendar invites and the agenda in 30m.
Carlos Nguyen: I'll open a short feedback doc for SI instructors to capture issues during the lab.
Samira Khan: Also creating a form for certification appeals/questions.
Jordan Lee: Dry-run invite sent. See you all Thu. :eyes:
Maya Patel: Closing loop — follow-ups: Samira publishes rubric, Carlos triggers sandboxes, Jordan runs dry-run, Priya uploads network tests. I'll drop the co-marketing checklist later. :rocket:
